[DX] DREXUN ARENA · GUIDE

How it works

Everything you need to know in two minutes. Short version: win your 1v1, climb the arenas, finish the month on top.

1 · Get in

  1. Open CS2 and press ~ for the console.
  2. Paste connect drexun.ggwp.cc:25401 and press Enter.
  3. Pick any team. The server puts you in an arena by itself.

Join the server

2 · The duels

1v1 arenas

Win and you move up an arena, lose and you move down. Arena 1 is the top.

Short rounds

30 seconds. The first kill wins. If time runs out, the round counts for nothing.

Your weapons

Every round has a weapon type (rifle, AWP, pistol …). Type !guns to pick yours.

Warmup

The first 90 seconds of a map are warmup. Nothing counts there.

3 · Rating and seasons

A new ladder every month

Everyone starts the month at 1000 rating. Win to go up, lose to go down.

10 rounds to get on the list

After 10 ranked rounds you appear on the leaderboard.

Top 5 win VIP

Finish the month in the top 5 and you win VIP. See VIP →

What counts

Only real 1v1s against players. Bots, warmup and private !duels never count.

4 · Levels and skins

XP every round

+25 for a win, +10 for a loss. Levels never reset.

Free skins

Type !skins. Every knife, glove and weapon is free; rarer finishes unlock as your level goes up.

Initiate 1Challenger 5Duelist 10Gladiator 20Champion 35Legend 50Mythic 75

5 · The commands you need

!gunsyour weapons
!skinsskins, knives, gloves, music
!rankyour rating and level
!topthe ladder
!profileyour full stats
!duel <name>a private duel
!afktake a break / come back
!reportreport a cheater

Type them in chat; nobody else sees them. !help in game lists the rest.

6 · Rules

  • No cheats, no exploits, no win trading.
  • Leaving in the middle of a duel counts as a loss.
  • 30 seconds without moving puts you in spectators (!afk to come back).
  • Be respectful: no hate, spam or advertising.
  • The staff decide. See a cheater? !report and what happened.

Questions

My skin doesn't show.
Type !wsrefresh. A grey skin in the menu needs a higher level. A plain knife after switching knife type: rejoin the server.
Why did I get only a few points for a win?
Your opponent had a much lower rating, or you played the same person several times in a row (it counts less each time until a 15-minute break or a new opponent).
What does "(new)" next to a name mean?
That player hasn't finished their first 10 ranked rounds this month yet.
Why am I in spectators?
You didn't move for 30 seconds. Type !afk to play again.
I typed a number and it didn't show in chat.
The map vote was open (the last 2 minutes of a map): your number counted as a vote.
Is my level gone when the month ends?
No. Only rating and wins/losses reset. XP, levels, titles and unlocked skins stay.
